hero.desc: We are your reliable partner for international logistics solutions, professional customs clearance, modern warehousing services, and the trade of high-quality food and beverage products from Europe and around the world.
s1.label: LOGISTICS
s1.title: Logistics Services
s1.text: Avetar Logistic GmbH can provide you with a complete range of logistics services across the European Union, Eastern Europe, the Middle East, and Asia:
s1.f1: Consulting on transportation and customs clearance
s1.f2: Selection of suitable transport solutions (own fleet or subcontracted carriers)
s1.f4: Transportation of oversized and heavy cargo
s1.f5: Cargo consolidation at our own warehouses
s1.f7: Warehousing services (our warehouses are located in Leipzig, Germany)
s1.f8: Customs warehousing (our customs warehouses are located in Leipzig)
s1.f9: Excise warehousing (our excise warehouses are located in Leipzig)
s1.f10: Application of excise stamps, labels, and product stickers
s1.text2: In Eastern Europe, we also provide the following services:
s1.text3: As all these services are provided by one company across multiple countries, we are able to offer a complete and integrated range of logistics solutions throughout Eastern and Western Europe, as well as the Middle East and Asia. We are confident that our services will be valuable to your business and that we can become a reliable logistics partner for your company.
s2.label: CUSTOMS SERVICES
s2.title: Customs Services
s2.text: Thanks to our customs and excise licenses, AtlantSovt can carry out all customs procedures for your goods both in Ukraine and in Germany:
s2.f3: Opening and closing T1 transit procedures
s2.f5: Issuance of EUR.1 movement certificates for European-origin goods
s2.text2: With our team of experienced professionals, we can efficiently process and handle any type of shipment.
s3.label: WAREHOUSE SERVICES
s3.title: Warehouse Services
s3.text: Through our German subsidiary, AVETAR Logistic GmbH, Atlant-SovT LLC offers a full range of warehousing services at the following address: Pönitzer Weg 2a, D-04425 Taucha. These services include:
s3.f1: Storage of all types of goods in standard warehouses
s3.f2: Storage of all types of goods in customs warehouses (we hold the necessary authorizations for customs warehousing and the storage of goods under customs control)
s3.f3: Storage of all types of goods in excise warehouses (we hold the necessary authorizations for excise warehousing and the storage of goods under excise control)
s3.text2: Thanks to our comprehensive customs and excise licenses, we can store any of your goods in our facilities under customs and excise control.
s4.label: TRADE
s4.title: Alcohol & Food Trade
s4.text: Thanks to our branch in Germany, AVETAR Logistic GmbH (www.avetarlogistic.de), Atlant-SovT LLC is a technical importer (importer) of alcoholic beverages, soft drinks and food products from all over the world, namely:
s4.text2: We offer both our own product lines and the ability to source and sell products of your choice. We provide a comprehensive "turnkey" service, including communication with the supplier, customs clearance, EUR.1 documentation, labeling of excisable goods (excise stamps and translation), logistics, and customs clearance in Ukraine.
ft.desc: Your reliable partner for logistics, customs clearance, warehousing services, and international trade from Europe and the world.
